Metadata.title: Wholesale & Retail Merchandise in Miami
Metadata.description: Clothing, home goods, curtains, bedding, perfumes and household products. Wholesale for stores and resellers, retail for everyone. Store pickup in Miami and delivery within the US.

WhatsApp.defaultMessage: Hello! I have a question about your products.

Footer.tagline: Wholesale and retail merchandise. Family-owned in Miami.
Footer.brandsNote: Product brands and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Home.title: Wholesale & retail merchandise for stores, resellers and families
Home.subtitle: Clothing, home goods, curtains, bedding, perfumes, household products and more. Browse the catalog, build your list and send it to us on WhatsApp.

trust.wholesaleBody: Bulk orders for businesses, single items for everyone.
trust.brandsBody: A wide selection of merchandise from trusted brands.
trust.pickupBody: Pick up your order at our Miami store.
trust.deliveryBody: We can deliver within the US.

steps.browseBody: Find products and choose colors, sizes and quantities.
steps.listBody: Add everything you need to your inquiry list.
steps.sendBody: Send your list in one tap. We reply with pricing and availability.

Home.pricingBody: Prices depend on quantity. Send us your list and we'll reply with a quote.
Home.ctaTitle: Have a question or a large order?
Home.ctaBody: Message us on WhatsApp. We speak English and Spanish.
